name: umpsa-timeout-edit
description: Remotion edit of IMG_7678.MOV: UMPSA handball timeout talk, vertical 9:16 for TikTok and Instagram Reels

scripts.preview: remotion render TimeoutEdit out/preview_raw.mp4 --props='{"preview":true,"guides":false,"music":true,"sfx":true,"voice":true}' --scale=0.5 --crf=23 --audio-bitrate=256k && scripts/master_audio.sh out/preview_raw.mp4 out/preview.mp4
scripts.stems: for s in voice music sfx; do remotion render TimeoutEdit out/stem_$s.wav --codec=wav --props="{\"preview\":true,\"guides\":false,\"music\":$([ $s = music ] && echo true || echo false),\"sfx\":$([ $s = sfx ] && echo true || echo false),\"voice\":$([ $s = voice ] && echo true || echo false)}"; done
scripts.qa:audio: npm run stems && python3 scripts/word_snr.py && python3 scripts/audio_qa.py
scripts.render:final: remotion render TimeoutEdit out/final_raw.mp4 --props='{"preview":false,"guides":false,"music":true,"sfx":true,"voice":true}' --crf=16 --audio-bitrate=320k && scripts/master_audio.sh out/final_raw.mp4 out/final.mp4
